shared.inputs: docs/whitebox.md is not shipped in this build, so SOUL rules plus the host loader (modules/whitebox.py load_scene) were followed. Per scene: layout_top.png, layout.json, bible/scenes/<id>/architecture.json and environment.json, runs/p4-env-concept-sb2/result.json (image defects).
shared.coordinate_convention: dimensions_m [X, Y, Z] with X = layout.json extent_m.x and Z = X*9/16 (the plan aspect is 2560x1440), so the plan covers the whole floor. Object xy = normalised plan position (same frame as the layout.json landmarks, top = north = -Z); elevation_m = centre height (host loader convention). The landmarks are inherited unchanged from layout.json.
shared.modelling_rule: Interior walls: inner face on the drawn floor edge, thickness outward; doors and windows at the drawn gaps with Bible widths, and lintel/head blocks closing the wall to the ceiling above each opening. Exterior buildings: solid bodies (their interiors are separate scene assets). Trees drawn as stumps are modelled as living trunks. Where the plan misdraws an object's own size against a Bible hard size (thistle, mushroom, nest, sticks, oak bole), the Bible size is used at the landmark point and marked inferred.
shared.collision_roles: wall | solid | soft (foliage/flora, walk-through or brush-past) | ground (flat markers) | decor (wall-face items) | boundary (fences)
